tools.name: get_mapping_target
tools.description: Actual target Object natural key, physical catalog, description, layer, lifecycle/locks and ordered registered Attributes with type, inferred type, nullability and descriptions. No internal IDs. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

tools.name: get_mapping_sources
tools.description: Eligible source contributions, each with role, rationale, mapping_order, lock and nested actual physical Object/Attributes. Scoped to this frozen target/Source System pair. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

tools.name: get_existing_mapping
tools.description: Single existing target binding/header with modeled Entity/Attributes, natural Attribute-name bindings, Object/Attribute transformation documents, dependency order, statuses and locks. Null document means unauthored. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

rules: Optional enablement and invocation; no-input/empty selects all eligible. Frozen prepared values only; no live DB, arbitrary SQL, code execution, ingestion Mapping reader, or downstream dependency inventory. Same-reader cursor restores selection. Unknown keys, changed selector with cursor, and unavailable/oversized results are errors; never silent truncation.
